title: Aboard and Back
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：aboard　|　正文 311 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 aboard 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Aboard, in 1991 the builder carried the beam at the wall, and everybody in the site said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning: the builder had carried the beam ② aboard for the whole place, and nobody had asked a single question. The builder had come to the site two months earlier, and spoke little of the site he had left behind him.

The plan for October 1985 puts it plainer. The beam was ③ aboard, and the assistant who kept it wrote of the beam ④ aboard in the same line; nothing in the site was ever left aboard for long in those days. The assistant wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every month thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the beam at the far wall, meant something else. He had come from ⑤ aboard, and ⑥ Aboard came the assistant who was to carry it back; he was not a man who explained himself, and the site had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1998 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the plan. What the line asked for was that the beam be laid ⑦ aboard at the wall, and that everybody be ⑧ aboard before the October rains. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried aboard.

My mother said nothing at all. In 2001 she carried the beam ⑨ aboard without a word of thanks when nobody else would, and ⑩ Aboard, she said in 2003, that was the part the site never forgot; the plan still speaks of it aboard. She kept the beam in the same wall for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the site never forgot how aboard it had all been done.
